name: Frederick James
one: Indie iOS maker. Ships consumer apps alone and co-builds Reception.sh, a SaaS for other app makers.
start: Native Swift, RevenueCat and a hard paywall. Apple Search Ads from day one on competitor keywords, $20 to $50 a day after $100 of free credits.
now: TikTok ads first, then organic: X content, TikTok and Instagram videos, automated slideshows. Localized pricing and screenshots, plus a lifetime plan.
lessons: Use a hard paywall with weekly, monthly and yearly plans. Adding a monthly plan raised his conversion.
Pricing: 7.99/w & 49.99/y. Adding 14.99/m boosted conversion. Hard paywall in RevenueCat.
Show a tasteful exit offer, like a lifetime plan, when people abandon checkout.
Localize pricing, screenshots and store info, then add a lifetime plan.
After I swapped to organic, this combo increased my revenue by about 30%.
Set a US base price, then scale it by each country's spending power.
Build a 12 to 13 step onboarding that sells the outcome, and iterate until 85% of users finish it.
13 step onboarding. Measured onboarding with PostHog. Iterated till 85%+ onboarding.
Ask for a rating during onboarding and keep the paywall minimal.
Ratings during onboarding (patched). Tweaked paywall till 3-4% conversion.
Rank your store page work in this order: screenshots, reviews, name and subtitle, icon.
1. App Screenshots. 2. Reviews. 3. Name & Subtitle. 4. App Icon.
Translate your store page into 40+ languages with Claude and the App Store Connect CLI.
do it with claude & CLI very easy and quick
Run Apple Search Ads from day one on competitor names.
Apple ads will carry you to at least 1k/mo
Give each TikTok creative $50. Scale the ones where CPA is under LTV, stop the rest.
Give each creative $50 of spend. After $50, if CPA < LTV then scale it.
Aim for profit on the first transaction early on.
Better for me: Aimed for profit on first transaction.
Share the build on X with videos.
Videos have been a big part of my growth. 400 to 5k+ followers in 2 months!
Automate slideshows for TikTok and Instagram once you have a base.
Automate slideshows instead. Create passive income.
Sell to a deep human need, read competitor reviews, and obsess over design.
Sell to a deep human need. Obsessed over design, feel & ui. Read reviews to see pain points.
Keep shipping ideas until one works.
Failed for 3 years, and 13 different ideas. Winning is simply losing on a long enough timeline.
Ignore early churn and fix the top of the funnel first.
Ignored churn. Noisy signal in b2c. Top of funnel more important at first.
